name: DIALOG acquisition of Tarpon Platform Systems (November 2023)
description: DIALOG Group Berhad acquired the entire equity interest in Tarpon Platform Systems Malaysia Sdn Bhd plus all tangible and intangible assets (including IP) of Tarpon Systems International II LLC on 15 November 2023. Two independently read pages print the same consideration in USD and RM; both recorded side by side. This is a corporate acquisition price for the platform-system business, NOT an WHP fabrication or development cost.
